mapper.select: SELECT id, article_id, prompt_config_id, prompt_snapshot, content, status, error_msg, tokens_used, model_name, interpret_count, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM news_interpretation WHERE article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, article_id, prompt_config_id, prompt_snapshot, content, status, error_msg, tokens_used, model_name, interpret_count, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM news_interpretation WHERE article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_interpretation ( article_id, prompt_config_id, prompt_snapshot, content, status, error_msg, tokens_used, model_name, interpret_count, create_by, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{articleId}, #{promptConfigId}, #{promptSnapshot}, #{content}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{tokensUsed}, #{modelName}, #{interpretCount}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
